items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: Uh, Dooley talks about him. I guess Dooley played with him.

ctx.x: It was of, uh, considerable influence to a slightly earlier generation than the Austin. Uh, Dooley talks about him. I guess Dooley played with him. Do you remember that Dooley had a brother in music?
